findings.title: Denied read access does not invalidate concurrent authorised responses
findings.trigger: A list request and selected-object GET overlap; the list is refused after current read access is lost, then the earlier authorised GET response arrives late.
findings.observed_source_result: hideUnavailable clears head and hides the body; the late continuation can install head again because alive stays true. Its revision UUID is rendered in data-diagnosis-revision outside the unavailable content gate.
findings.recommendation: On read-authority refusal make this workspace terminal-invalidated using a ref/epoch, abort outstanding controllers, increment reads, clear cursor and block every awaited continuation from installation after invalidation. Verify same-scope late responses cannot repopulate text, state or metadata.
